title: Stingray Patterns of Dominant Weights
summary: We study the set $W_{r,e,w}\ $ of dominant weights of $\mathfrak{sl}_r$ arising from partitions of fixed $e$-weight $w$. For $e$-cores, we show that $W_{r,e,0}\ $ decomposes as a disjoint union of simplices indexed by compositions of $r$. For general $w$, we prove that $W_{r,e,w}\ $ is a disjoint union of copies of these simplices, with multiplicities determined by the corresponding quotient data, yielding in particular a closed counting formula for $|W_{r,e,w}\ |\ $.
